title: How to Build a $10M Solo AI Business (Zero Code)
description:
✅ Get Your FREE AI Company Operating System here: https://go.danmartell.com/4sZQT3t

AI is changing the rules of entrepreneurship. The next generation of billion-dollar companies won’t be built by massive teams, they’ll be built by individuals using AI agents.

In this video, I break down how to rethink business growth in the AI era and the exact process to build a powerful one-person company

Manus: https://manus.im/
Claude: https://claude.ai/
Gemini: https://gemini.google.com/

----

Manus Prompt Template:
Build a software product that cleans up someone's data and give them insights on the right next step they should take in their business

Only build these screens:

[Screen 1 + Login]
[Screen 2 + Data Input]
[Screen 3 + Output and Insights]

Auth: email + password (basic).

Keep the UI clean, minimal, fast. No extra features.

“Make it functional with basic styling.”

“No role permissions, no complex settings, no admin dashboard.”

“If something is uncertain, implement the simplest version.”
